about.title: La Puente Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: La Puente sees its share of everyday traffic collisions, with public records showing 116 injury crashes and 160 people hurt in the most recent reporting year. Corridors like Amar Road, Temple Avenue, Hacienda Boulevard, and Valley Boulevard carry heavy volume, and collisions tend to cluster on Friday evenings when commuters and weekend traffic overlap. Whether you were rear-ended near a signal on Hacienda or sideswiped on Valley Boulevard, the aftermath can mean medical bills, missed work, and confusing calls from insurance adjusters. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves, but we connect La Puente residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can review the police report, talk to witnesses, and handle communications with insurers. That first conversation is free, and there's no obligation to move forward. The sooner you reach out, the easier it is to preserve evidence before it disappears.

whyChoose.title: Why La Puente Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Two-Year Clock, Shorter If a Government Vehicle Is Involved
items.desc: California generally gives you two years to file a car accident claim, but that window can shrink to as little as six months if a city or county vehicle was involved. Connecting with an attorney early helps make sure that deadline doesn't slip by.

items.title: Comparative Fault Won't Automatically Sink Your Claim
items.desc: Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still recover damages even if you're partly at fault for the crash. An attorney can help make sure your share of blame isn't overstated by the other side.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering, No Upfront Cost
items.desc: California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in car accident cases, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning you owe nothing unless they recover for you.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's usually best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers often use those statements to shift blame or minimize your injuries. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my accident happened on Amar Road or another busy La Puente street?
items.answer: High-traffic corridors like Amar Road, Temple Avenue, and Hacienda Boulevard see a steady flow of reported collisions, and evidence like traffic camera footage or skid marks can disappear quickly. Acting fast helps an attorney gather what's needed while it's still available.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and the attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no fee unless they recover money for you. The initial conversation carries no obligation.
